en: Black‑and‑white view of a European city street lined with tall 19th‑century apartment or hotel buildings in neoclassical style. The façades have ornate window frames, iron balconies and shutters. A busy sidewalk scene shows many pedestrians in early 20th‑century dress. A ground‑floor establishment with a sign reading "café" has awnings and hanging lamps above its entrance. Trees shade the left side and market or shop awnings extend along the street.
